description: Golden schema scenarios. Score = every expected_edge (dependent -> prerequisite) present in dependency_tree, and no expected_absent edge present.

input.schema_info:
=== Origin: origin_1 (postgres) ===

  Table: public.companies
    Columns: company_id, org_title, industry, city, created_at

  Table: public.people
    Columns: person_id, name_full, email_addr, employer_id, created_at
    FK: public.people.employer_id -> public.companies.company_id
    Sample: {person_id=1, name_full='Sara Ahmadi', employer_id=3}

=== Origin: origin_1 (postgres) ===

  Table: public.companies
    Columns: company_id, name

  Table: public.people
    Columns: person_id, name, company_id
    FK: public.people.company_id -> public.companies.company_id

  Table: public.orders
    Columns: order_id, buyer_id, seller_company_id, total
    FK: public.orders.buyer_id -> public.people.person_id
    FK: public.orders.seller_company_id -> public.companies.company_id
